partnershipPlan: A community advisory group of five people with lived experience meets every two months; the peer researcher co-leads interviews and co-authors the pathway proposal.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: They said someone from housing would come and see me, but I was discharged on the Friday and nobody knew where I went.
items.implication: Measure discharge before contact as a failure point.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Half the form asks for documents people lost two addresses ago; I send it anyway and it comes back.
items.implication: Record which items are missing on declined referrals.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: When I know the social worker by name, the referral works; when it arrives by email from someone I have never met, it stalls.
items.implication: Explore named contacts in the qualitative strand.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I will tell you my story, but not if it ends up with the benefits people.
items.implication: State the non-disclosure rule in the consent material.

summary: Four composite voices on early discharge, the referral form, named contacts and data trust.
